chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:

Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام said: The supererogatory prayer on Friday is six rak'ahs at the beginning of the day, and six rak'ahs when it rises higher, and two rak'ahs when the sun declines. Then you perform the obligatory prayer, then pray six rak'ahs after it.

key_terms.إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: when the sun passes the meridian
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ النَّافِلَةُ: the supererogatory prayer performed in addition to the obligatory prayer
key_terms.صَدْرَ النَّهَارِ: the early part of the day
key_terms.عِنْدَ ارْتِفَاعِهِ: when the day has risen higher
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, the specified time for this ruling

ai.seo_question: How are the nafilah prayers on Friday to be performed according to Imam Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the arrangement of the nafilah prayers on Friday before and after the obligatory prayer. It outlines specific times and numbers of rak'ahs, showing a juristic ruling concerning Friday devotional worship.
